name: rust-protobuf
notes: rust-protobuf 3.x (crate `protobuf`, stepancheg) with protobuf-codegen generated structs (protoc backend, default settings: HashMap maps, Vec<u8> bytes, String strings).
Wire: Message::parse_from_bytes / Message::write_to_bytes allocate a new message / Vec per iteration.

JSON via protobuf-json-mapping (print_to_string / parse_from_str), the only JSON path the library offers; it works through the generated static reflection tables rather than generated per-message JSON code.

protobuf-json-mapping has no compact-output option: print_to_string always emits ": " and ", " separators, so json_bytes is ~10% larger than the whitespace-free reference JSON (content is otherwise identical canonical ProtoJSON).
Map iteration order of HashMap is unspecified, so wire_bytes_match may be false for datasets with maps (medium, large); sizes still match.
Build: cargo build --release --locked with the default release profile (no LTO / PGO / target-cpu).
